failure_mode.returns_on_failure: COMMIT CONFLICT: _overwrite_with_retry retries CommitFailedException and CommitStateUnknownException up to COMMIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS (:58, default 5, env ICEBERG_COMMIT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) with a table RE-LOAD each attempt; on exhaustion it raises and the ECS task fails -- LOUD. CONTRACTS-ENSURE FAILURE: caught at :306-308, prints 'WARN: GRAPH_CONTRACTS_ENSURE_FAIL ...' and the run CONTINUES by design (the nodes/edges write is the declared critical path). EMPTY INPUT: no exception at all -- see silent_degrade_paths.
silent_degrade_paths: *** THE SHARP ONE: `if all_nodes:` (:330) and `if all_edges:` (:357) guard the writes. If cmd_derive returns an EMPTY node or edge list, the overwrite is SKIPPED ENTIRELY -- no exception, no WARN, and NO 'ICEBERG_NODES_WRITTEN' marker. The table then retains the PREVIOUS run's rows. A consumer reading graph_nodes cannot distinguish 'tonight's estate, freshly written' from 'last night's estate, silently retained' -- both are a fully-populated table with a plausible snapshot_ts, because snapshot_ts belongs to the rows that were written, and stale rows carry the OLD batch_ts while nothing forces a reader to check it. THIS IS THE ANTI-CORRELATED SHAPE: the more completely the derive fails, the more intact the table looks.
'WARN: GRAPH_CONTRACTS_ENSURE_FAIL' is a WARN on a rc=0 run -- a consumer scoring the run on exit code sees success while graph_contracts may be absent.

The image tag is ':latest' and ECR image_tag_mutability is 'MUTABLE' (item2a.tf:14), while the taskdef pins no digest -- so 'the nightly runs THIS source' is not decidable from the trigger chain. Running bytes older than built bytes would pass every rung of this card.

Usable as load-bearing substrate WITHIN three named limits: (1) the trigger->script binding is INFERRED, not measured -- taskdef rev 6 carries command=null and the image tag is mutable, so this card cannot certify that the nightly runs the source it describes; (2) an empty derive silently retains stale rows with no marker and no error; (3) the artifact has TWO OTHER WRITERS -- comp_aws_cli.py cmd_iceberg_commit and the incremental_updater Lambda -- which this path neither knows about nor coordinates with, and one writes with a DIFFERENT mutation shape (filtered vs full replace), so a nightly full overwrite can silently discard an incremental update. None of the three blocks use; all three change what a consumer may CONCLUDE, which is why they are named rather than folded into a SOUND.
